title: Astral experiences to places I felt were real - Have you seen these two places?
content: My astral experiences (lucid dreaming on steroids where I leave my body completely), do not really align much with the various described "worlds" outside of "mall world" that I see people describe on here. That doesn't mean they aren't out there as a real physical space on some plane of existence, however. A few places I have been to that are sadly very dark in nature: **THE CASINO on the planet PLUTO** \- I once got into an elevator with a bunch of people on Earth. The elevator was in some sort of government or office building. Many of the people were in suits and ties. Mostly all men... They were not able to see me or interact with me. I didn't even know why I was getting onto the elevator, I simply just decided to do it. Quickly, the elevator sort of transformed into a traveling UFO in the shape of a box - much like the "doctor who" flying box. It lifted up and into a worm hole - we flew at what felt like the speed of light almost... I remember passing by some of the planets in our solar system. Within minutes, we finally arrived to Pluto. How I knew it was pluto was because of how far out we had traveled into the solar system. I just knew somehow.... As I got off the elevator, I quickly realized I was in some sort of "fun house casino"... This happened years ago, and so sadly I can't recall all the things I saw. I can only say it was very corrupt. The feeling of corruption was everywhere. People were playing with Gold coins and there were many playing tables.. I wandered around and also saw a type of alcoholic Bar there... Most of the interior finish of the Casino was Red and Gold. Lots of red... I recall getting back on the Elevator to get the hell out of there and tried to go somewhere else.. I use to remember the other places I went, but I no longer can. Years after having this experience, I did read ONE single "insider" account of someone saying that the global elite have "elevators" they can slip into, press a certain button, and it actually takes off into worm holes for space travel. They're disguised in various government buildings. I mean, perhaps a full of Sh\*\* claim. But, I did have an astral experience doing just this. **THE HOUSE ON THE HILL IN THE MOUNTAINS which ISN'T actually made of Earthly matter.** This is one of the scariest things I've ever experienced. I literally FLEW in astral form to this place. It was like I was on a mission and knew what I had to do. I could nearly move at the speed of light arriving. I flew into what was actually a facility of sorts. The building looks more like a 3-4 story house (mansion really), deep in the country side somewhere in Europe - There are wild flowers that cover the hillside and mountains all around. Its summer at this time. You can tell that this place is far away from civilization and must be on 100's if not 1000's of acres. Inside the facility are long white hallways. Its very "lab" like. Sadly, there are orphaned children living inside of it by themselves. I find the children and they all crowd around me, pointing at me, looking at me floating in the air. I know at this point that they could see my astral form and perceived me as a type of apparition. They were excited and all trying to touch me and talk to me. I was very worried about them and felt very panicked... I said *"What is this place? Where are your parents?".*.. They all explained they had no parents. These children were aged anywhere from 6-12, perhaps. Just a guess. There were at least 10 of them. They were allowed to be together to keep each other company. But, there were no adults in the building at this time. None. I said... *"What are you here for? Why are you here?"*.... They all had looks on their faces as if this was all they had ever known. I will never forget one of the boy's faces. His face is burned into my mind forever. He was super fair skinned and had bright red curly hair that stuck out like an afro - freckles everywhere. A very vacant and disassociated look on his face. Moving on with the astral experience - I suddenly noticed there were "changing rooms" of sorts with brown gate-like swing styled slotted doors. A whole row of them... I decided to float over and open one.. I peaked inside and I saw all sorts of costumes, wigs, and creepy outfits..... Somehow, my stomach sank. My heart began racing, and I felt rage. SHEER rage. I understood in an instant. Somehow I understood that these children were being abused, and told to dress up in these odd costumes. They were being harmed here and they were kept permanently in this space. I was sick to my stomach. I yelled to them... *"THAT'S IT. I AM GETTING YOU ALL OUT OF HERE.. LET'S GO... ".*.. I rushed over to a window and saw a chair.... The kids said to me "You can't get out of here, its impossible".. I said.. "What are you talking about.. I'll just break this window"... I mustered up all my strength, and threw a chair directly at the window with all my might. The glass shattered. Within moments of the shattering, I saw an ELECTRIC blue line suddenly appear - within seconds it built back the damaged window... I immediately realized this place was NOT constructed of earthly glass/wood and normal building materials. It was actually some sort of higher dimensional building blocks that were atomically OVERLAYED into reality. We were definitely on Earth, but the building was tangible and LOOKED real. But these were not classic 3rd dimensional materials.... I realized it was hopeless. Immediately, a man in a suit busted into the facility, realizing someone was there... I saw him running down the hallway at us, when I suddenly leapt THROUGH the wall (I was in astral form so I could do this with ease), and out into the sky.... I flew as quick as a hummingbird 100's of feet away into the sky. I decided to myself.. "I must memorize this place, I have to see where I am..."... When I looked back down to see where I had just flew from, that's when I saw the green hillside in the mountains with wildflowers all around. I knew it was in the middle of nowhere. I then heard a voice..... An etheric voice from an entity who knew what I had just seen. The male voice said... *"This is but a taste of what will happen in the future... You are looking at Fallen Earth, Plan B... I need you to be here just a little while longer "*.... I knew that what he meant was - in this earthly incarnation. In this life. Whoever it was, he knew that I was tortured by the things I had witnessed. I could sense his authoritative nature as a spirit - a great powerful spirit that was full of compassion and authority. I knew he was good. Now, "PLAN B"? I can only guess at what he meant. NONE of what I have described was influenced by stories I read, movies, the media.. I am sure of this. **\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_** I've had 100's of astral experiences where I fly to very real places and explore.. Sometimes on other worlds even. About two-three years ago, it all stopped. What I can only term as "the astral police" basically stopped me from being able to leave my body. I haven't been able to leave my body and astral fly anywhere since. I remember hearing a voice say to me as I was in a trance like state: "You've seen enough", and experiencing a huge, many thousands of pounds BLACK weight fall on top of my body while I was in a trance like state. I once even heard two men at the side of my bed saying "It's time to reset her.. " They were in lab coats... Make what you want of all of that. I'm spiritually dead now, and no longer can astral project. I can't see or hear anything. When I dream, its essentially in black and white and all just stems from the subconscious. Dreaming like a normal earth person now sucks. Someone doesn't want me using my abilities any longer. These two "spaces" are just examples of all the hundreds of places I've been over the last 20 years or so. If you've seen either of these two, do share your story/experience. Something is pushing me to share these two experiences today. I felt an urgency to share.
